answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked before it can earn reputation or claim scarce rewards; let peers challenge suspicious clusters, and slash the bond only when independent evidence shows coordinated identities double-counted the same work. A real newcomer can recover the stake by behaving honestly, while a sybil operator must tie up capital for every fabricated identity and risks losing it. Spreading identities across cedar, meadow, and copper-themed profiles does not evade the shared cost.
